question: Which materials for vessels are enumerated in address to the goddess?
premises: A vessel made of clay is named.
A vessel born of tortoise is named.
Vessels born of bell metal and of copper and metal are named, in address to the goddess.
inference: Clay, tortoise, bell metal, and copper-metal vessels are enumerated.
uncertainties: kūrmajaṃ may refer to material origin or source; taken as given by surface.
plain_english: Clay, tortoise-born, O goddess, bell metal-born, and copper-metal-born vessels.
